shape: unit_sheet: an eight-engined bomber, four engine pairs under a long swept wing, long body, tall fin; ~19.4 x 22.6 x 5.0 m (0.4 x a B-52); visible weapons FAB-500, quad M3 12.7 mm tail, Kh-101; modelSize 19.8 x 22.62 x 5.7 m.

features.feature: the long slab-sided fuselage (Team) with panel lines as paint, the Team stripes on spine and flanks, the refuelling receptacle
the stepped cockpit: four windscreen panes, eyebrow windows, the nose radome and the chin sensor turrets
the shoulder wing, 35 degrees of sweep with anhedral, flap seams (paint), outrigger gear pods, tip tanks, wing lights
four twin-engine pods on pylons: intake lips and fan faces, nozzles
the tall fin with its rudder seam and Team band, the tailplane, the beacon
the quad 12.7 mm tail turret (Mount_gun) with its glazing
the bomb bay: two doors on their hinge pivots (a later bomb-run pass opens them), hazard bands, the racked FAB-500 load, the drop point
the Kh-101 cruise missiles on the inner-wing pylons

weapons.note: the bombs drop from the bay; the doors are separate pivots for the pending bomb-run pass
aim Hull; the right missile's Muzzle_rocket.001 kept

budget.note: over the maximum is information only (owner rule 02/10)

team_zones: the fuselage, the wing, the fin (Team), the spine and flank stripes
wreck: aircraft break into Part_wing (prompt 34 wrapper) and fall
faction_style: Cold War strategic bomber; no real insignia
